thread:
alex: FYI customer reported an unexpected auto-renewal invoice and a second invoice created right after. believes they were charged twice. PO requirement on file (PO-5421) so they need an invoice/credit note that references the PO. they want reversal + confirmation for accounting.

alex: invoices mentioned: INV-2026-9876 and INV-2026-9877. payment settled on 2026-03-12. customer says only one subscription should have renewed. :eyes:

sarah: @alex can you paste the payment processor txn id and last4? i can start the refund/credit note once i have the charge id. we should also confirm tax/VAT handling before issuing a credit note.

alex: charge id from processor is ch_3KqZ7y2pX, last4 4242. customer confirmed billing email matches acct-4281. they also attached their PO PDF (internal ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2419).

sam: sounds like a potential double-invoice race from billing-worker v2.3.1. i've seen a retry loop where webhook ack failed but job still created invoice on second attempt. i'll pull logs for acct-4281.

billing-bot: Invoice creation events (acct-4281):
- 2026-03-12T14:02:07Z invoice_create id=INV-2026-9876 status=paid
- 2026-03-12T14:02:09Z invoice_create id=INV-2026-9877 status=paid
- webhook delivery to /billing/webhook returned 500 at 14:02:08Z, retry fired at 14:02:09Z

sam: confirmed. webhook returned 500 due to transient DB lock; worker retried and created a second invoice because dedupe key wasn't persisted before the failure. root cause: missing idempotency guard in worker for that codepath. filing a patch now.

alex: ok customer needs immediate remediation. @sarah can finance do a reversal of INV-2026-9877 and issue a credit note referencing PO-5421 and VAT summary? please CC customer on the email.

sarah: starting reversal now. i will void INV-2026-9877 and create credit CN-2026-0009 referencing PO-5421. will process refund to card ch_3KqZ7y2pX. note: because VAT was applied on original invoice we will include VAT adjustments on the credit.

sarah: (action log)
```
POST /internal/finance/credits
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-9877",
  "credit_note": "CN-2026-0009",
  "reason": "Duplicate invoice due to webhook retry; customer PO-5421",
  "refund": {
    "processor_charge_id": "ch_3KqZ7y2pX",
    "amount": "full",
    "method": "card"
  }
}
```

sarah: refund submitted to payments team. estimated settlement reversal 3-5 business days. i'll attach credit PDF to the support ticket and email the billing contact.

alex: please also mark the subscription as single-renewed and set a manual flag to prevent automated retry until patch is deployed. customer asked for a confirmation email they can send to their AP team.

sam: patch in review: add pre-insert dedupe record before returning 201, and a compensating cleanup if processing fails. will roll to canary in eng-staging. changelist: billing-worker v2.3.2.

mia: heads-up for later: run a backfill to find invoices created within 10s of each other for the same acct/subscription in last 7 days and queue for manual review. i'll open an ops job.

sarah: credit note CN-2026-0009 created and attached to ticket SUP-2419. email to customer sent with subject: "Credit issued for duplicate invoice INV-2026-9877 (PO-5421)". included VAT breakdown and expected refund window.

alex: customer replied: "Thanks — we received the credit note and will confirm with AP. can you add the PO number to the invoice header for future renewals?"

sarah: added PO-5421 to customer billing profile (acct-4281) and updated renewal template to include PO if present.

sam: deploying hotfix to billing-worker tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will monitor invoice_create rate and webhook error rates.

alex: closing loop with customer once reversal posts. leaving thread open for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
